notes.title: Anarchy Starts! Now!!
notes.notes:
One small step for a man can be a great catalyst for the gaming world. [i]AnarchyField[/i] will launch within a few hours.

[i]AnarchyField: Infinite Euphoric Level Destruction[/i] is a revolutionary game with a focus on destruction and physics. [i]AnarchyField[/i] is a breath of fresh air in the modern gaming industry which lacks and even detests innovation.
